title: One long cycle: n − 1 swaps
notes: 2 3 4 5 6 7 1: every value sits one slot before its home, and 1 wraps around to the end, so the values form one cycle through all 7 slots. Every swap happens at i = 0: 6 swaps, n − 1, the most there can be. The last swap sends two values home at once. Nothing is missing.
